subject: Marketplace invoice credits: allocation + VAT evidence request
messages:
From: Julie Park <julie.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marketplace Billing Team <billing@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace invoice credits: allocation + VAT evidence request

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re doing well. We’ve started our month-end close and noticed a set of unallocated AWS Marketplace credits and a number of withheld VAT reversals that haven’t been applied to invoices on our ledger (attached: acme_credit_report_Q1.csv). Specifically: 

- 2028-03 credits flagged as "marketplace_hold" (total €38,720) not appearing on the March invoice reconciliation.
- Multiple VAT withholdings tied to EU-based sub-accounts where we requested evidence but haven’t received a packaged response.

Can you please confirm: 
1) Who on your team will own mapping those credits to invoice lines?
2) Whether Redwood can provide VAT evidence for withheld amounts (invoices + VAT breakdown + any EU tax certificates).
3) ETA for a ledger export that includes the marketplace allocation ids so our AP team can reconcile.

We’re hoping to close these items by EOD Friday so our controllers can book adjustments this month. If it helps, we can schedule a quick 30-min sync — we’re flexible tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Julie Park
Finance Manager — Billing & Collections
AcmeCloud

Attachments: acme_credit_report_Q1.csv (CSV, 42KB)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice credits: allocation + VAT evidence request

Julie — thanks for the note and the report. I’ve looped in Marissa and Karthik from finance + marketplace ops to lead the reconciliation. Quick answers to your asks: 

1) Owners: Marissa will drive the mapping + ledger sweep; Karthik will own SKU/entity alignment across AWS/GCP/Azure; Vanessa will coordinate any withheld VAT evidence with our compliance team.
2) We can provide VAT invoices and certificate scans where applicable — we’ll bundle them into a single evidence packet.
3) ETA: we’ll aim to deliver a first pass ledger export and credit mapping by Wednesday EOD. Finalized packet by Friday if no blockers.

Action items I’ve assigned internally:
- Marissa: produce mapping + reconcile unallocated credits.
- Karthik: confirm SKU & entity mapping and note any marketplace-specific tax treatments.
- Vanessa: pull VAT evidence and confirm if additional paperwork is required for EU withholdings.

I’ve attached a stub export request we’ll use to pull the ledger.

If you’re available tomorrow at 15:00 UTC we can do a 30-min screen share to walk through the report.

Best,
Logan Wright
Dir, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice credits: allocation + VAT evidence request

Thanks Logan / Julie — I’ll take point on the reconciliation. Proposed plan: 

1) Triage & scope (today): run the credit_id join between our marketplace settlement export and the invoicing ledger to surface unallocated credit lines.
2) Mapping (Wed): Karthik to provide SKU/entity mapping and call out any marketplace-specific fee lines (brokerage, platform fees) that might be splintering credits.
3) Evidence packet (Thu): Vanessa to assemble VAT invoices, tax certificates, and the signed payout memos for the withheld items.
4) Sweep & confirmation (Fri): deliver a consolidated CSV with allocation_id, invoice_number, credit_amount, VAT_amount, and evidence links for Acme AP to ingest.

Quick asks from my side: 
- Karthik, can you prioritize the SKU mapping sheet (I’m attaching the reconciliation_playbook.md for context).
- Vanessa, any blockers on pulling VAT scans from our compliance archive? If you need help with DocuSign logs, tell me and I’ll pull it.

We’ll plan the 30-min sync with Julie for 15:00 UTC tomorrow.

—Marissa
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace invoice credits: allocation + VAT evidence request

Folks — did the initial SKU/entity mapping pass this morning. High-level notes: 

- AWS Marketplace credits are sometimes applied to "listing fees" lines; those are routed to a different revenue entity in our ledger (EU vs. non-EU). That mismatch explains ~€21k of the gap.
- GCP marketplace refunds have a different invoice reference pattern (refund_id vs allocation_id) — I added a crosswalk column to handle that.
- For VAT: EU withholdings require invoice-level evidence plus the marketplace settlement file showing the withheld tax. We have most of the pieces; a few legacy invoices are missing VAT registration numbers.

I’m attaching the SKU mapping file (sku_mapping_20280402.xlsx) — it contains a column "reconcile_risk" to flag items that need legal/compliance review. I’ll work with Vanessa to get the missing VAT registration numbers.
